decisions.reason: The vacuum thermoforming unit has two years of investment, a dedicated website page, and is close to the firm's established digital manufacturing offer, so escalation of commitment strongly favors keeping it.

Although it has a website page, the orthopedic shoe last is distant from the firm's announced digital medical-technology direction, reducing centrality and making management more willing to drop it if results disappoint.
The post-curing unit is close to the established offer and central to the firm's processes, but its lower public commitment results in moderate escalation, so it is likely kept.
